answer: Inline JSON is the positional `payload` arg, a raw JSON string (not a path): parser.py:664 `task.add_argument("payload", nargs="?")`; parsed by `_load_json_mapping` via json.loads (operations.py:234-236) into a flat task-field mapping, e.g. {"title":...,"from_drawer":...}.

`--from-yaml` takes a file path (parser.py:665); operations.py:1070-1071 passes Path(args.from_yaml) to `_load_yaml_mapping`, which reads it with yaml.safe_load (operations.py:226-231). Content must be a top-level mapping of the same task fields as JSON.

Any `.md` under `desk/drawer/` except README.md/Board.md works; use e.g. `desk/drawer/tasks/task-rw-f0-x.md`. Matching is by filename/stem only (operations.py:559,574), so front matter is irrelevant. `desk install` scaffolds desk/drawer/ (workspace.py:178,231).

Rule is in code: exact name/stem matches win, else case-insensitive stem substring; >1 match raises ValueError 'Ambiguous drawer selector ...' (operations.py:574-580); no match raises FileNotFoundError (operations.py:577). Note tests only cover the unknown case.

Only `title` is effectively required: compiler.py:35 does raw_payload["title"]; `id` is derived from the title slug via id_pattern (compiler.py:37). argparse lists --title optional (parser.py:667) but missing title raises KeyError during compile.

parse_task_input uses `if from_yaml: ... elif payload:` (operations.py:1070-1073), so YAML wins over inline JSON; the two never merge. The flag still overrides both at the CLI layer, per the task's scope (operations.py:21).
`payload = operations.parse_task_input(args)` at operations.py:19; YAML and JSON share one dict and are mutually exclusive (elif), so only one populates it (operations.py:1068-1073).
Both forms work: selector is compared to path.name and path.stem, with a case-insensitive stem-substring fallback (operations.py:574-575), so `rw-f0-x`, `task-rw-f0-x`, and a full path all resolve.

`resolve_drawer_source(self, selector: str) -> Path` (operations.py:551); `attach_drawer_source(self, payload: dict, drawer_file: Path) -> dict` returning payload with the repo-relative from_drawer (operations.py:583-592). Both are needed.

Order is already correct: parse -> resolve/attach -> create_task_bundle (operations.py:19-28). attach must precede creation because compiler.py:64 copies from_drawer. Only the selector's source needs widening.
